items.proposed: no 'other' eligibility biomarker (drop A's 1p/19q and molecular-GBM-feature rows as selection biomarkers)
items.reason: "IDH wildtype diffuse glioma with molecularly features of glioblastoma (EGFR amplification, TERT promoter mutation, or concurrent gain of Chromosome 7 and loss of Chromosome 10)" and "Prior evidence of 1p/19q co-deletion" (exclusion) are diagnostic criteria that define glioblastoma, like IDH-wildtype, not molecular selection. Neither is candidate-matched, so the primary outcome is false either way.

Both pembrolizumab and olaparib are candidates (experimental_combination) given together with temozolomide in "Arm A - Pembrolizumab plus olaparib and temozolomide", so each candidate's partners include the other candidate as well as temozolomide. Regimen is combination either way.

Cohort 2 is randomised 1:1 to Arm A (pembrolizumab + olaparib + TMZ) or "Arm B - Pembrolizumab monotherapy" (EXPERIMENTAL), and the title is "Pembro +/- Olaparib w TMZ", so Arm B works as the reference for the olaparib + TMZ addition. However, it is an active investigational arm, not standard of care or placebo.

note: any_molecular_selection is false only if the molecular glioblastoma features and 1p/19q exclusion are treated as diagnostic (like IDH-wildtype). If XL counts them as selection biomarkers, it becomes true; the primary outcome stays false either way. control_arm_from_other_arms depends on whether an active investigational reference arm counts as a control under manual R8.
